headlines.snippet: Iraqji has received the American response to the seven-day plan proposal. This communication is part of ongoing diplomatic efforts.

headlines.snippet: The Saudi regime is pursuing an unattainable victory in Yemen. The conflict continues with no clear resolution in sight.

headlines.snippet: Hamas has called for the launch of the "Great Dawn" campaign in support of Jerusalem. This is a call to action for supporters.

headlines.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
headlines.snippet: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire that was subsequently extinguished. The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported the incident.

headlines.title: Syria, EU discuss new agreement, recovery and Israeli withdrawal
headlines.snippet: Syria and the EU are discussing a new agreement, recovery efforts, and Israeli withdrawal. Syria urged the EU to demand Israeli forces' withdrawal.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia reaffirms support for Sudan’s stability, sovereignty
headlines.snippet: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's commitment to Sudan's stability and sovereignty. This was during a phone call with Abdel Fattah al-Burhan.

headlines.title: Syrian FM, EU foreign policy chief discuss ties, economic recovery and reconstruction
headlines.snippet: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani met with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas. They discussed bilateral relations, regional developments, and reconstruction efforts.

headlines.title: Syria allows non-exclusive agencies for foreign vehicle and tire firms
headlines.snippet: Syria will permit foreign vehicle and tire firms to register non-exclusive agencies and open branches. The Ministry of Economy and Industry announced this change.

headlines.title: Syria is rising, al-Sharaa tells UN—but challenges remain at home
headlines.snippet: Syria is reportedly experiencing a resurgence, according to al-Sharaa, though domestic challenges remain. The focus is on translating international acceptance into economic progress.

headlines.title: FlyDubai pilot tried to crash Israel-bound passenger jet after stabbing colleague, Netanyahu says
headlines.snippet: The Flydubai pilot reportedly attempted to crash the Israel-bound passenger jet after stabbing a colleague, according to Netanyahu. This information emerged after the incident.

headlines.title: Gas pipeline blast near Damascus forces 3 Syrian power plants offline
headlines.snippet: A gas pipeline explosion near Damascus has forced three Syrian power plants offline. The blast caused significant disruption to energy supply.

headlines.title: Saudi crown prince welcomes UAE vice president in Riyadh
headlines.snippet: Saudi Crown Prince welcomed the UAE vice president in Riyadh. The meeting aimed to strengthen bilateral relations between the two Gulf nations.

headlines.title: Saudi crown prince warns of regional threats, hails ‘indivisibility’ of Gulf security
headlines.snippet: Saudi Crown Prince warned of regional threats and highlighted the "indivisibility" of Gulf security. He emphasized the need for collective security.

headlines.title: FlyDubai passenger jet pilots in bloody mid-air fight, Israeli media reports
headlines.snippet: Flydubai passenger jet pilots were reportedly involved in a mid-air fight, according to Israeli media reports. The incident led to the flight's diversion.

headlines.title: UAE orders investigation into flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE has ordered an investigation into the Flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident. The probe seeks to understand the circumstances leading to the diversion.

headlines.title: The Plaza, formerly Lamcy Plaza, set to reopen in first half of 2027
headlines.snippet: The Plaza, formerly Lamcy Plaza, is scheduled to reopen in the first half of 2027. This signifies a redevelopment project.

headlines.title: UAE outlines action against employers for late salaries
headlines.snippet: The UAE has outlined measures against employers who fail to pay salaries on time. This addresses concerns about workers' rights.

headlines.title: Babar Azam sold for base price in ILT20 season 5 auction
headlines.snippet: Babar Azam was sold at his base price during the ILT20 season 5 auction. This concerns player acquisitions in a cricket league.

headlines.title: Ai Everything Abu Dhabi 2026: Microsoft, VDURA, IFS to show AI at work
headlines.snippet: Ai Everything Abu Dhabi 2026 will feature demonstrations of AI by companies like Microsoft, VDURA, and IFS. The event focuses on artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Türkiye, Syria reject claims of meeting between Syrian government, Hezbollah officials
headlines.snippet: Türkiye has dismissed claims of hosting a meeting between Syrian government and Hezbollah officials. Both Türkiye and the Syrian government deny such an event occurred.

headlines.title: Dual UK-Iranian national arrested over UK airbase incident, police say
headlines.snippet: A dual UK-Iranian national has been arrested in connection with an airbase incident in the UK. The investigation is described as highly complex.

headlines.title: Saudi-led coalition blames Houthis for drone attack on Medina power station
headlines.snippet: The Saudi-led coalition blamed the Houthis for a drone attack on a Medina power station. The attack disrupted a transformer but not the electricity grid.

headlines.title: Israel approves repatriation flights for 1,800 stranded passengers after Flydubai suspension
headlines.snippet: Israel has approved repatriation flights for 1,800 stranded passengers following the suspension of Flydubai services. Israeli airlines will operate these flights.

headlines.title: US' Rubio to visit Iceland, Greece, Portugal next week
headlines.snippet: US Secretary of State Rubio is scheduled to visit Iceland, Greece, and Portugal next week. Meetings will focus on security, defense, and economic cooperation.

headlines.title: Şimşek tells investors Türkiye has avoided systemic risk in fund turmoil
headlines.snippet: Turkish Treasury and Finance Minister Şimşek stated that Türkiye has avoided systemic risk amid fund turmoil. Authorities acted quickly to contain market problems.

headlines.title: Bangladesh quota reform sees women lose out on government jobs
headlines.snippet: Bangladesh's quota reform has led to fewer government job opportunities for women. The change followed a student-led uprising replacing quotas with merit-based hiring.

headlines.title: UK signals broader tech regulations beyond U-16 social media ban
headlines.snippet: The UK is signaling broader tech regulations beyond the planned social media ban for under-16s. This indicates a more interventionist approach to technology companies.

headlines.snippet: Coffee's journey from Ethiopian goats to its global status is explored. The drink has become a worldwide staple, enjoyed in various ways.

headlines.snippet: Beyond traditional espresso, five unusual coffees from around the world are highlighted. Different regions offer unique coffee flavors and preparations.
